About the ClientOur client is a U.S.-based strategist and business coach with a high-impact personal brand spanning coaching programs, keynotes, a podcast, and a community for entrepreneurs. They operate a lean, fast-moving team that partners with vendors and requires precise execution across time zones. The culture values speed, high standards, measurable outcomes, and email-first communication.
Why does this role exist?
The client needs a senior, AI-savvy project lead who will diagnose operational inefficiencies and implement AI/tooling to dramatically increase speed and quality. This role owns priority projects end-to-end, coordinates closely with the principals (Christine and Charles), and ensures reliable 24-hour handoffs between Eastern and Philippine time zones. The aim is to replace fragmented workflows and “yes-person” execution with proactive leadership, automation, and measurable impact.

The Impact you’ll make

AI Operations Diagnosis Automation
  • Audit existing workflows, identify bottlenecks, and recommend AI/tool solutions.
  • Build and maintain automations (including n8n) and necessary integrations.
  • Pilot, measure, and iterate on AI interventions to deliver time savings and quality gains.

Project Ownership Delivery
  • Define scope, milestones, timelines, and success criteria; manage cross-functional initiatives end-to-end.
  • Run stand-ups/check-ins; track risks and dependencies; ensure on-time delivery.
  • Produce and maintain clear SOPs, documentation, and dashboards for visibility.

Cross-Time-Zone Coordination Handoffs
  • Create and enforce a 24-hour handoff playbook and SLAs between Philippine and Eastern time teams.
  • Ensure clear daily summaries, next actions, and owner accountability.
  • Provide administrative backups as needed (travel, meeting prep, decks, scheduling).

Vendor Stakeholder Management
  • Coordinate with existing vendors (e.g., high-end LinkedIn specialist), align on objectives, and ensure timely execution.
  • Translate strategy into tasks and automations; QA deliverables and close gaps.
  • Train/enable internal team members and vendors on updated processes and tools.

Executive Partnership
  • Work hand-in-hand with Christine and Charles as a proactive, assertive strategic partner.
  • Prepare materials for meetings, manage calendars/invites, and ensure email-first communication cadence.
  • Surface risks early, propose solutions, and push projects forward decisively.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required:
  • Proven experience using AI as a specialist specifically within Project Management (designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-enabled workflows).
  • Hands-on automation experience, including n8n familiarity and integrations across common business tools (email, calendar, CRM, LinkedIn).
  • Senior-level project management owning cross-functional initiatives end-to-end with measurable outcomes.
  • Experience collaborating with U.S.-based executives and working Eastern Time hours.
  • Exceptional communication and an assertive, proactive approach
  • WFH Set-Up:
    • Computer with at least 8GB RAM, an Intel i5 core processor/AMD Ryzen 5 Processor and up.
    • Internet speed of at least 40MBPS
    • Headset with an extended mic that has noise cancellation and a webcam
    • Back-up computer and internet connection
    • Quiet, dedicated workspace at home
Your Superpowers:
  • Technical: n8n automation, API integrations, AI/LLM tools, prompt/workflow design, process mapping, data hygiene, QA, documentation/SOPs.
  • Project Leadership: scope/timeline/risk management, stakeholder alignment, vendor coordination, KPI tracking, change management.
  • Soft Skills: resourceful problem-solver, assertive and accountable, bias to action, excellent written email communication, high ownership, cross-time-zone communicator with strong follow-through.
You should apply if...
  • You’re a proactive builder who diagnoses problems, proposes solutions, and drives decisions without waiting for direction.
  • You’re comfortable pushing back, setting priorities, and holding others accountable to timelines and SLAs.
  • You thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy working directly with executives, and can coordinate smooth 24-hour handoffs.
  • You care about measurable impact, not activity—your default is to automate, document, and iterate.
What to expect...
Work Setup:
  • Remote position
  • Must have a reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace
  • Required to provide own computer with Intel Core i5 or something similar or higher operating system
Working Hours:
  • 40 hours per week
  • Monday - Friday: 9:00 am - 5:00 pm (Eastern Time)

LocationOur Principal Technical Product Owner - DoiT Partner Platform will be an integral part of our Product Management team. This role is based remotely in the East US, Canada, the UK or Ireland.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity
We’re hiring a Principal Technical Product Owner to drive the strategy, rapid delivery, and iteration for the DoiT Partner Platform. This platform enables cloud partners, resellers, and service providers to operate, monetize, and scale their cloud businesses across major hyperscalers. The platform is designed to help partners manage the operational and financial complexity of the cloud ecosystem, including cloud billing, margin management, customer lifecycle workflows, and partner-led service delivery.

This senior role is built for a leader with a "technical founder" mindset. You will act as the tip of the spear for all DoiT Partner Platform initiatives, serving as a leader amongst the product team to guide the broader product vision and set the standard for execution. You will bring relentless curiosity about how the cloud ecosystem works, a deep understanding of hyperscaler partner programs, and the confidence to test ideas directly with domain experts. The right leader will have held hands-on roles within the cloud ecosystem—such as cloud operations, cloud billing / FinOps, or partner operations—and will bring direct experience working with channel business models. In addition to hands-on execution, you will help direct strategy, align cross-functional teams, and mentor other technical product owners across the organization.

Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Delivery

  • Act as the "tip of the spear" for the DoiT Partner Platform: Serve as the foremost product authority and a leader amongst peers, driving alignment across multiple product squads and setting the bar for product excellence.
  • Own the overarching strategy, delivery, iteration, and learning velocity for major platform components.
  • Partner with VP-level leadership to define strategic direction, translating it into clear problems to solve and shippable scope.
  • Direct and mentor other Technical Product Owners to elevate product management practices, ensuring cohesive execution across the entire platform portfolio.
  • Drive the feedback loop across teams: discover → define → build → release → measure → iterate, repeatedly.
  • Review technical designs, reason about complex tradeoffs and constraints, and understand their impact on delivery timelines and system behavior, without being the primary implementer.

Deep Partner & Ecosystem Understanding

  • Leverage your hands-on experience within the cloud ecosystem and understanding of channel, reseller, and partner business models.
  • Develop deep empathy for the workflows of cloud partners: billing operations, margin management, reseller customer management, support operations, and service delivery.
  • Use direct partner conversations and operational insight to identify friction, gaps, and strategic opportunities to improve how partners run their cloud businesses.

Cloud Billing & Partner Operations Expertise

  • Bring strong understanding of cloud billing constructs, marketplace programs, margin models, and partner incentives across hyperscalers.
  • Help shape complex platform capabilities that manage or abstract complexity in areas such as:
    • Multi-cloud billing aggregation.
    • Partner margin and discount models.
    • Customer invoicing and revenue operations.
    • Usage and cost transparency.
    • Marketplace and private offer workflows.

Executive & Partner Validation

  • Speak frequently with key partners (aiming for 3–5 conversations a week) and internal stakeholders to validate ideas, refine workflows, and test assumptions.
  • Engage deeply with executive stakeholders at cloud partners, MSPs, SIs, and resellers to understand how they operate their cloud businesses.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently: share concepts early, take feedback openly, synthesize input into strategic decisions, and explain "why" in a way that builds trust and consensus among peers and leadership.

Engineering-Embedded Technical Product Ownership

  • Operate as a core leader working closely with Engineering leaders—present in daily collaboration, crisp in decision-making, and pragmatic about constraints.
  • Partner with Engineering leads on sequencing, technical tradeoffs, and delivery planning—ensuring product intent survives implementation realities.
  • Ensure components are cohesive across UX, APIs, data, and operational behavior, supporting partner-grade reliability and scalability.

Quality, Outcomes, Trust & Governance

  • Define what “success” means for the platform portfolio with clear metrics (partner adoption, onboarding speed, billing accuracy, workflow completion, retention, reliability signals, partner-reported impact).
  • Instrument learning: ensure releases are measurable and that insights reliably flow back into portfolio prioritization.
  • Ensure platform capabilities account for the operational realities of the cloud partner ecosystem, including billing accuracy, financial reconciliation, and auditability.

Qualifications

  • Extensive product leadership experience with 10+ years of direct experience in the cloud ecosystem, ideally across roles such as cloud operations, FinOps, partner operations, or building platforms that serve cloud customers or partners.
  • Proven ability to act as a "player-coach"—driving high-level strategy, executing hands-on alongside engineering, and directing/mentoring other product owners as a respected peer leader.
  • Strong experience with cloud billing systems, cost and usage data, or revenue operations within cloud environments.
  • Deep understanding of the cloud partner ecosystem (resellers, MSPs, SIs, distributors, marketplaces). Candidates have likely worked within the partner ecosystem at some point in their careers.
  • Experience building or operating platforms that serve channel or partner-driven business models.
  • Strong product sense for turning messy operational problems into clear scope and shipped value with an excellent user experience.
  • Technical fluency in cloud fundamentals and APIs across AWS, Google Cloud, and/or Azure.
  • Coding experience is a plus—enough to collaborate effectively with engineers, reason about feasibility, and understand system behaviors.
  • Must have demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate product specifications and development.
  • Excellent communication skills: ability to engage deeply with partners, cloud experts, and internal stakeholders at the executive level.
  • A bias for action and continuous improvement: you ship, measure, learn, and iterate.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • You are universally recognized by your peers and leadership as the driving force and primary authority ("tip of the spear") for the Partner Platform's product direction.
  • Platform capabilities ship frequently with clear partner value.
  • Partner feedback loops are strong and visibly influence the overarching roadmap.
  • Adoption across the partner ecosystem increases and partner operational workflows improve measurably.
  • Billing accuracy, financial transparency, and operational scalability improve for partners using the platform.
  • Engineering teams consistently have clarity on the next most valuable increment to build—and why.
  • Other product owners on the team are effectively mentored, aligned, and elevated through your leadership.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

Position Summary:

The hands-on technical backbone of Nightingale College’s Banner SaaS environment. You’ll resolve escalated issues, manage configurations across modules, build and maintain integrations through Ethos and Data Connect, and keep the platform running smoothly day to day. Working closely with the Administrator III, you’ll grow into deeper platform ownership while mentoring the Administrator I.

Role and Responsibilities:

Configuration & Escalation Resolution

Serve as the primary escalation point for complex Banner issues, owning configuration management across Student, Finance, HR, and Financial Aid modules.

  • Resolve complex Banner issues escalated from Administrator I and functional teams.
  • Manage module configuration changes with proper testing, documentation, and rollback planning.
  • Lead testing and validation efforts during Ellucian SaaS release cycles and configuration changes.
  • Monitor and optimize job scheduling, automation workflows, and batch processes.

Integration & Data Connect Execution

Build, troubleshoot, and maintain integrations between Banner and campus systems using Ethos APIs and Data Connect, under the architectural direction of the Administrator III.

  • Implement and maintain Ethos-based integrations connecting Banner to LMS, CRM, Financial Aid systems, and third-party vendors.
  • Build and support automated data pipelines and business process workflows through Data Connect.
  • Troubleshoot integration failures, monitor error rates, and resolve data sync issues.
  • Collaborate with the data team to ensure accurate data feeds to downstream systems (e.g., Snowflake environments).

Experience & Platform Support

Support the day-to-day operations of Ellucian Experience and platform extensibility under the guidance of the Administrator III.

  • Assist with Experience dashboard configuration, card management, and user role assignments.
  • Support low-code extensibility efforts and test institution-specific customizations.
  • Help assess and implement new platform features delivered through continuous SaaS updates.

Security, Compliance & Documentation

Manage Banner security architecture and maintain documentation aligned with compliance standards.

  • Oversee Banner security roles, classes, and access governance controls.
  • Maintain architectural and process documentation aligned with FERPA, GLBA, and institutional compliance standards.
  • Support disaster recovery testing and audit remediation efforts.

Collaboration & Mentorship

Partner with institutional departments and vendors to optimize system functionality. Provide mentorship to Administrator I, building skill development across Ethos, Data Connect, and Experience.

Qualifications and Education Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent experience.
  • 4–6 years of Ellucian Banner experience, with exposure to the SaaS platform ecosystem.
  • Working knowledge of Ellucian Ethos, including API-based integrations and the Ethos Data Model.
  • Experience with Ethos Data Connect for building and maintaining data pipelines and automated workflows.
  • Familiarity with Ellucian Experience configuration and administration.
  • Strong SQL proficiency including complex joins, query optimization, and data validation.
  • Familiarity with database structures within Banner for troubleshooting and operational support.
  • Experience managing SaaS release testing cycles and configuration change management.
  • Understanding of higher education regulatory compliance (FERPA, GLBA preferred).
  • Proficiency with scripting languages such as PowerShell or Python desirable.

For decades, DTN has been the silent force behind some of the world’s most critical industries—helping businesses navigate complexity, uncertainty, and risk with smarter, faster decisions. From agriculture to energy to weather intelligence, our proprietary Operational Decisioning Platform transforms raw data into decision-grade insights—enabling companies to optimize supply chains, ensure market stability, and safeguard infrastructure against disruption. We don’t follow trends—we set the standard for precision, trust, and operational impact.

DTN is at an exciting inflection point. Building off a foundation of financial strength, profitability, and industry trust, we’re accelerating growth and expanding our global footprint. Our purpose-built solutions—powered by AI and honed by decades of vertical expertise—are helping some of the world’s most significant enterprises thrive amid operational constraints and uncover new opportunities in a fast-changing world.

Job Description:

DTN is seeking a Senior Supplier Management & Compliance Specialist to oversee and manage our global supplier portfolio, ensuring compliance, minimizing risk, and optimizing supplier relationships. This role partners cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Legal, Product, and Customer Experience teams to ensure supplier contracts, data usage, and compliance standards are maintained at the highest level.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in supplier management, contract compliance, and stakeholder engagement, with the ability to proactively identify risks and drive process improvements across a complex, global supplier ecosystem.

What You Will Be Responsible For

  • Manage DTN’s global supplier portfolio, including exchange data suppliers, ensuring compliance with contractual terms and usage rights
  • Monitor and assess supplier risk profiles, proactively identifying risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities
  • Ensure all supplier data usage complies with contractual terms and regulatory requirements
  • Partner with Product and Procurement teams to support supplier selection, contracting, and risk mitigation strategies
  • Lead supplier compliance audits and manage ongoing supplier risk mitigation and escalation processes
  • Coordinate implementation of regulatory and legislative changes impacting supplier contracts and data usage
  • Manage supplier-related operational processes, including RFPs, requisitions, purchase orders, invoicing, and documentation
  • Maintain organized, accurate, and accessible supplier and exchange documentation
  • Develop and deliver quarterly supplier compliance reports and insights to stakeholders
  • Facilitate training and drive internal awareness of supplier compliance requirements
  • Partner with Operations, Sales, and other stakeholders to support exchange compliance and customer data usage requests
  • Review and validate customer use cases to ensure compliance with exchange policies and licensing requirements
  • Manage DataFeed Licensing Agreements (DFLA) to maintain ongoing compliance

What You Will Bring to the Position

  • Proven experience in supplier management, compliance, or procurement roles
  • Strong knowledge of supplier relationship management best practices
  • Experience interpreting and negotiating contracts, including services and goods agreements
  • Familiarity with data contracts and compliance requirements
  • Strong stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence across functions
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other MS Office applications
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication, reporting, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Team-oriented mindset with the ability to collaborate effectively across the organization

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience working with exchange data suppliers or market data compliance
  • Experience supporting regulatory or ISO-aligned environments
  • Experience managing complex, global supplier ecosystems

What You Can Expect from DTN

  • Competitive Salary
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible working hours
  • Remote work model (position dependent)
  • Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Plans
  • 6% 401K matching
  • Unlimited access to 13k+ courses via learning platform to support employee career advancement
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Compensation
The targeted hiring base pay range for this position is between $73,500 and $97,500. DTN is a pay for performance organization, which means there is the opportunity to advance your compensation with performance over time. The actual base pay offered for this position will be dependent upon many factors, including but not limited to: prior work experience, training/education, transferable skills, business needs, internal equity and applicable laws. The targeted hiring base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for market competitive variable pay and benefits.

About DTN:

DTN is a global data and technology company helping operational leaders in energy, agriculture, and weather-driven industries make faster, smarter decisions. Our Operational Decisioning Platform turns complex data into decision-grade insights—empowering customers to expand their margins, accelerate growth, and outpace risk. With more than 1,200 employees globally, DTN serves the companies that feed, fuel, and protect the world.

At DTN, we value clarity,trust, and action. We’re a team of problem-solvers, outcome-drivers, and industry nerds who believe that precision matters – and that mission is at the core of what we do.

  • Trust Built: We earn it. We keep it. We protect it. Our neutrality, precision, and integrity are non-negotiable.

  • Confidence-Driven: We help customers move with clarity and conviction. We bring the data and operational knowledge leaders need to act.

  • Built for Industry: We speak operations because we come from operations. Our expertise is forged in fuel terminals, fields, flight paths, and forecasts.

  • Future-Forward: We see what’s coming- and we’re ready. We help customers lead through change with smarter decisioning.

Recruitment Fraud Notice:

DTN is aware of incidents where external parties have impersonated our organization, issuing fraudulent communications and/or job offers. Please be advised that all legitimate communication from DTN will come from an official @dtn.com email address or through our Paradox AI automated scheduling platform (Talent IQ). Any offers are extended directly by our Talent Acquisition team following a formal interview process.

If you receive a suspicious message or offer claiming to be from DTN, please do not engage. Contact our Talent Acquisition team at Careers@dtn.com to verify the legitimacy of any communication. Report any fraudulent messaging as phishing or spam.

DTN is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applicants of all backgrounds, including minorities, women, veterans, and individuals with disabilities.

Helping students and families feel better takes a dedicated team. As a member of Hazel’s Mental Health team, you will help expand access to evidence-based care in schools across Ohio.

raw.description:
At Veracity, we aim to be a different kind of insurance partner – one that is free from outside investors, venture capital, or the pressures of a corporate parent.

Ours is a culture of empowerment – one that believes in effort, results, and accountability. We believe that transparency fosters trust, trust fosters growth, and that growth drives innovation. Our commitment to rigorous evaluation and relentless execution lead to rapid evolution.

We answer only to the small business owners we serve, and this independence allows us to stay focused on what matters most: helping their businesses thrive by providing expert guidance and best-in-class insurance policies.

We’re growing fast and want you to be a part of it!

We’re seeking a driven and talented Content Amplification Manager to lead how our existing content gets repurposed, distributed, syndicated, and optimized across social, video, communities, PR, and third-party publishing.

Reporting to the Director of Content, this remote role manages the Content Amplification Team and builds the repeatable systems, workflows, and channel playbooks that helps our content reach more people and deliver more measurable impact. This role is ideal for someone who loves content operations, distribution, channel optimization, and repurposing. You won’t own the editorial calendar; you’ll own the engine that extends the life, reach, and performance of the content we already create.

This is a systems + leadership role: you’ll build repeatable amplification programs, run them across channels, measure what works, and keep improving the process over time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Content Amplification team, including helping to hire, onboard, and stand up our video capability
  • Build the operating rhythm for intake, prioritization, sprint planning, QA, reporting, and optimization
  • Create channel playbooks for social, video, repurposing, syndication, and thought leadership
  • Partner closely with PMMs, Paid, Email, Marketing Ops, Data/Dev, and Compliance to keep launches aligned and moving
  • Build and improve AI-assisted workflows for briefing, repurposing, QA, reporting, and distribution at scale
  • Expand reach through third-party publishing, guest posting, syndication, influencer/partner programs, and executive/employee advocacy
  • Own measurement standards, best practices, and reporting loops that turn learnings into next actions
  • Help the team find what’s working, amplify it harder, and feed those insights back into the broader content engine
  • Required to perform other duties as requested, directed, or assigned

Requirements and Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years in content marketing, digital marketing, distribution, or amplification
  • 2+ years of people management experience, including hiring, coaching, and performance management
  • Ability to build a team, function, or workflow from scratch and know how to turn ambiguity into process
  • Understand how to operationalize AI beyond “I use it sometimes”
  • Ability to build repeatable playbooks without building a bureaucratic nightmare
  • Strong in cross-functional collaboration and can work well with creative, technical, and compliance-minded partners
  • Understand how to measure what matters and separate signal from vanity metrics
  • If working from a remote locale, can travel for required Marketing / occasional leadership or other in-person corporate events (<5%)

Preferred

Gates is a leading manufacturer of application-specific fluid power and power transmission solutions. We push the boundaries of material science to engineer solutions that continually exceed customer expectations.

Let's simplify it, think belts and hoses. Found in motorcycles, conveyor belts, cars, tractors, blenders, vacuum cleaners, bicycles, & 3D printers just to name a few. Because why not do it all?

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

As an innovation leader, we look for ambitious, analytical, forward-thinking, open-minded, and well-rounded individuals to join our global team. Located remotely in your geographic location or in our Rochester Hills, MI office, we are seeking a Global CVT Business Development Manager for Powersports and Scooters, you will take charge of overseeing and driving the strategic direction for the CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission) business across multiple global markets. This role requires a dynamic leader who can work closely with key internal teams—including Product Development, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), and Gates AR teams—while also engaging directly with global Business Development teams and customers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Global CVT Strategy Development: Lead the creation and execution of the global CVT strategy for both Original Equipment (OE) / Original Equipment Service (OES) and Aftermarket Replacement (AR) channels, ensuring alignment with business objectives and market demands.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product Development and PLM teams to coordinate market trends, customer needs, and go-to-market strategies, ensuring seamless alignment with global testing, production, and supply chain activities.
  • Global Business Management: Manage and refine the global strategy for the CVT business, with a specific focus on expanding and strengthening relationships with large, international CVT customers.
  • Support for Global Race Teams & Sponsorships: Provide support for global race teams and sponsorships specifically tailored to the CVT product line, fostering brand visibility and product performance in high-profile environments.
  • Market Intelligence & Coordination: Monitor and analyze market trends, customer requirements, and competitive landscapes across various regions to proactively identify business opportunities, market needs, and areas for growth.
  • Customer Relationship Management: Maintain and grow relationships with global customers, working to understand their needs and ensuring that product offerings are aligned with customer expectations.

Requirements and Preferred Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Engineering Technology or Business (MBA preferred).
  • Minimum of 10 years of professional experience with at least 5 years business development.
  • Proven experience in business management, particularly in overseeing global product portfolios and customer relationships within the Powersports or Scooters industry.
  • Strong background in CVT technology or automotive parts, ideally in both OE/OES and AR markets.
  • Strategic thinking with the ability to manage cross-functional teams, drive collaboration, and influence key stakeholders across the organization.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage with senior leadership, global teams, and customers.
  • Experience in managing global strategies, especially in large, diverse international markets.
  • Highly organized with a strategic and data-driven approach.
  • Adaptable and proactive in addressing global business challenges.
  • Collaborative team player, able to influence and drive action at all levels of the organization.
  • Travel up to 40% both domestic and international.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship.

  • Sales Incentive Plan Eligible
  • Relocation is not provided
  • Medical, Dental, Vision insurance and other voluntary benefit options: benefits begin on the first day of the month immediately following your date of hire

  • 401(k): 3% company contribution and additional 3% company match

Founded in 1911 in Denver, Colorado, Gates is publicly traded on the NYSE. raw.description:
Growth Engineer (AI-Native) · iTmethods

An AI-native builder who owns high-velocity agentic GTM demand and growth across our strategic product portfolio. Forge (Managed Runtime/Governed Infrastrc ure + Reign (AI Governance & Assurance Platform) scaling this year. You design the strategy, orchestrate multi-agent workflows, run the Claude agents, and ship the autonomous pipeline end to end. Multiple products. Many launches. One operator behind it all. CEO and CRO are your direct partners. Decisions in hours, not weeks.

Why this role exists

iTmethods is a 21-year, profitable enterprise platform company that has rebooted AI-native. We are shipping and relaunching multiple products across our portfolio. Forge (AI governance and modern DevOps), Reign (enterprise AI governance and Assurance), and more rolling out this year. We sell into highly regulated enterprises in financial services, healthcare, pharma, defense, and semiconductors.

This is a high-velocity, initiative-focused role built for executive speed. You will own the agentic GTM motion across every product launch and relaunch on a modern agent-powered stack that is already live. You operate at executive cadence. No middle-management lift. Decisions in hours, not committees.

What you will own

  • The number, across the portfolio. Marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline for every product you operate on.
  • The agentic launch motion. Demand engineering for each product launch as it ships. New initiatives kick off on a quarterly cadence; you orchestrate the agentic playbook and compound it launch after launch.
  • The stack. HubSpot, Clay, Claude agents, ZoomInfo, and our internal Campaign Manager and Sales Manager surfaces. You configure, automate, and orchestrate the multi-agent system yourself.
  • Data discipline. Encoded ICP per product, clean living segments, continuous scoring.
  • Governed execution. Every agent and workflow runs inside Reign's governance envelope, audit-ready by default.

Your first 30 days (AI-native cadence)

  • Week 1-2 · Wire. Encode ICP per product, wire HubSpot lifecycle, Clay and ZoomInfo enrichment, Claude agent workflows, measurement framework.
  • Week 3 · Ship. Launch playbook live on the first two product motions, always-on nurture activated per ICP, content engine connected to capture.
  • Week 4 · Compound. Trigger-based ABM on regulatory events (EU AI Act, SR 26-2, DORA, FDA PCCP), reliable MQL to SQL handoff, reusable agentic playbook documented.

How you will work

  • You build in the stack (HubSpot, Clay, ZoomInfo, Claude agents). Not by briefing others to.
  • You leverage our internal AI operating system
  • You have an engineering team of builders behind you. Our dark factory ships new agent capability daily; the same builders who ship Reign and Forge work alongside you.
  • You operate at executive cadence. Direct line to CEO and CRO. Decisions in hours. No committees. No middle-management lift.
  • You operate at launch velocity. Multiple products shipping simultaneously means context-switching between motions weekly.
  • No high-volume AI slop. Precision and trust over noise, because we sell into banks, hospitals, and defense.

Who you are (must-haves)

  • AI-native builder, not AI-curious manager. You have shipped multiple production agent or LLM workflows. You write your own prompts, compose your own skills, configure your own MCP connectors. This is the filter.
  • Hands-on fluency with HubSpot plus Clay-class tools and ZoomInfo or comparable enterprise data platform. Configured by you, not briefed.
  • Built and owned demand gen or growth at a B2B enterprise or regulated-industry SaaS.
  • Light code comfort. TypeScript or Python at read-and-modify level. JSON-LD and YAML at author level.
  • You write, build, and analyze. Not a vendor manager.
  • Track record selling into long, regulated enterprise cycles where trust is the gate.

Compensation

Competitive. Benchmarked against Toronto B2B SaaS and the North American AI-native growth-engineering market.

How to apply

Send a short note. Include one example of an agent, workflow, or campaign you personally built (not briefed) that produced measurable pipeline. A short paragraph plus link beats a long resume.

Two questions we will ask

  1. Walk us through a Claude or OpenAI skill you shipped in the last 90 days.
  2. Show us a HubSpot or Clay agentic workflow you built yourself.

The fine print

  • This is an active, funded role. We are hiring now.
  • We use AI-assisted tools for resume screening and interview scheduling. Final hiring decisions are made by humans.
  • Candidates reaching the final interview receive a decision within 45 days.
  • iTmethods is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on merit and on what you have built. Canadian work experience is not required.

Creating Peace of Mind by Pioneering Safety and Security

At Allegion, we help keep the people you know and love safe and secure where they live, work and visit. With more than 30 brands, 12,000+ employees globally and products sold in 130 countries, we specialize in security around the doorway and beyond. Additionally, in 2024 we were awarded the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, which recognizes the most engaged workplace cultures in the world.

National Account Project Manager - Stanley Access Technologies, Remote

Stanley Access Technologies, a division of Allegion, is recognized as an industry leader in the manufacturing, installation, and servicing of automatic doors. Our growing product and service offerings have driven significant growth for our service business. Join our world class team of diligent problem solvers, innovators, fresh thinkers, and communicators who excite and inspire others.

National Account Project Manager

The National Account Project Manager is a fast-paced, multi-tasking role responsible for end-to-end management of national account projects (approximately 450–550 projects per PM). You will be the day-to-day face of Allegion to assigned customers, responsible for entering and managing orders in D365, coordinating with internal teams (Credit, Contracts, Factory/Release, Billing), tracking and driving shipments and installations, and escalating issues proactively to keep projects on schedule.

Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. The company does not intend to provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, TN, etc.) for this employment position.

At Allegion, we recognize that great talent and breakthrough ideas can come from anywhere. That’s why this position offers a flexible remote work arrangement, with occasional on-site visits as needed based on the role. Whether you’re working remotely or collaborating in person, we’re committed to providing the tools, support, and dynamic environment you need to succeed. At Allegion, your career thrives where innovation meets flexibility, empowering you to achieve your goals while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

While this is the current structure and we currently have no plans to change, we reserve the right to make changes to the remote schedule as needed at the Company’s discretion.

What You Will Do:

  • Manage 450–550 national account projects from order intake through final installation and closeout.

  • Read and interpret architectural drawings and specifications to identify required products and ensure compliance with project requirements.

  • Enter and maintain orders in D365 (Dynamics 365), including release of orders to the factory and ordering Class 2 parts for distributor orders.

  • Coordinate with Credit to resolve credit holds and ensure timely order processing.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers — provide status updates, gather installation dates, and respond to questions.

  • Collaborate with internal branch offices to drive seamless project execution by delivering complete project files, detailed documentation, and clear installation instructions.

  • Track each project’s status in a centralized tracker; maintain accurate, up-to-date project information (order status, ship dates, install dates, issues, next steps).

  • Proactively follow projects to ensure on-time shipment and installation; if a shipment or install does not occur, gather required information and take corrective actions to get the project back on track.

  • Work with the Contracts team to obtain signed agreements and with Billing to ensure accurate and timely invoicing.

  • Escalate issues promptly and appropriately using Microsoft Teams and phone calls (preferred) rather than relying solely on email.

  • Communicate cross-functionally with Factory, Operations, Distribution, and Service teams to resolve delays or quality issues.

  • Provide regular reporting to account leadership on project health, risks, and recovery actions.

  • Maintain documentation and audit trails for project decisions, changes, and approvals.

  • Support continuous improvement by identifying process gaps and contributing ideas to increase efficiency and on-time performance.

  • Travel: less than 10%

  • Preference for candidate to be in Eastern or Central Standard Time.

What You Need to Succeed:

  • 2-3+ years of project management or account management experience in manufacturing, distribution, or construction-related fields; experience with Auto doors/access controls or related products is a strong plus.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) or similar ERP systems.

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Excel.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of projects (400+ annually).

  • Excellent customer-facing skills and the ability to build credibility and trust with national accounts.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Proven ability to escalate effectively and drive cross-functional resolution.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and adapting to changing priorities.

Core Competencies for Success:

  • Organization and time management — capably prioritize and manage many simultaneous tasks.

  • Communication — clear, concise, and proactive verbal and written communication.

  • Accountability — owns issues, follows through to resolution, and takes responsibility for outcomes.

  • Customer focus — acts as a reliable, responsive contact for customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Team collaboration — works across teams to remove barriers and deliver results.

Why Work for Us?

Allegion is a Great Place to Grow your Career if:

  • You're seeking a rewarding opportunity that allows you to truly help others. With thousands of employees and customers around the world, there’s plenty of room to make an impact. As our values state, “this is your business, run with it”.

  • You’re looking for a company that will invest in your professional development. As we grow, we want you to grow with us.

  • You want a culture that promotes work-life balance. Our employees enjoy generous paid time off, because at Allegion we recognize that you have a full life outside of work!

  • You want to work for an award-winning company that invests in its people. Allegion is proud to be a recipient of the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award for the second year in a row, recognizing our commitment to employee engagement, strengths-based development, and unlocking human potential.

What You’ll Get from Us:

  • Health, dental and vision insurance coverage, helping you “be safe, be healthy”  

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

  • A commitment to your future with a 401K plan, which currently offers a 6% company match and no vesting period 

  • Health Savings Accounts – Tax-advantaged savings account used for healthcare expenses

  • Flexible Spending Accounts – Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare and/or dependent daycare expenses

  • Disability Insurance –Short-Term and Long-Term coverage, paid for by Allegion, provides income replacement for illness or injury

  • Life Insurance – Term life coverage with the option to purchase supplemental coverage

  • Tuition Reimbursement  

  • Voluntary Wellness Program – Simply complete wellness activities and earn monetary rewards

  • Employee Discounts through Perks at Work 

  • Community involvement and opportunities to give back so you can “serve others, not yourself”

One Identity is looking for an experienced Senoir UX designer to join an Agile development team. This team builds software to simplify and improve the management of critical enterprise data.

  • Develop and maintain design systems, style guides, and pattern libraries to ensure consistent and cohesive user experiences across multiple product teams.

  • Ability to host workshops and ideation sessions
  • Ensure designs are accessible and inclusive for all users, incorporating principles of universal design where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with peers in the UX team, product managers, developers, and leadership to define and evaluate detailed product requirements and UX standards.
  • Contribute to our team’s iterative design practice, based on Agile and Lean methodologies. 
  • Become knowledgeable of our products, intimately familiar with all aspects of the end-to-end user experience, and the customers who use our products. 
  • Model a user-centric design process in all work, advocating for customer experience and data-informed decision making. 
  • Define and incorporate interaction and visual UI (User Interfaces) patterns for consistency within and across products. 
  • Pro-actively communicate with partners and stakeholders using Azure DevOps, Confluence, Teams, and other tools as appropriate. 
  • Conduct usability testing and use other qualitative and quantitative research methods to drive and evaluate designs based on the strategic vision for the product.

Company Overview
Flatgigs is an innovative technology company that specializes in creating scalable applications for the gig economy. We are looking for a Full Stack Developer proficient in Django and React to join our passionate team. This role is crucial to our mission to connect freelancers and clients through efficient and user-friendly platforms.

Job Overview
As a Full Stack Developer at Flatgigs, you will design, develop, and maintain server-side and client-side components for our web applications. Collaborating with UI/UX designers and product managers, you will turn complex requirements into scalable, functional solutions that enhance user experience. Your involvement will straddle all aspects of the development life cycle, from initial conception to deployment and continued maintenance.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop scalable web applications using Django for back-end services and React for front-end user interfaces.
  • Collaborate with the design team to translate UI/UX wireframes into responsive and efficient web applications.
  • Implement RESTful APIs to connect front-end and back-end systems.
  • Optimize web applications for maximum speed and scalability.
  • Understand the requirements of the platform and design architecture that supports a high load of users.
  • Conduct code reviews to maintain code quality and best practices.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and improve existing applications.
  • Ensure cross-platform optimization for mobile responsiveness.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proven experience in full stack development, specifically with Django/Python and React.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and their design principles.
  • Experience with database management systems (SQL, PostgreSQL, or similar).
  • Proficiency in front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Familiarity with version control systems (such as Git).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively within a team.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Docker or Kubernetes for containerization.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and Agile methodologies.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.

Toast customers who managed several restaurants a few years ago are now expanding their business and adding new locations. New enterprise customers are looking to leverage Toast technology to support the growth of their business in new ways. These exciting new opportunities will require Toast to bolster our product offerings.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Comfortable working with an Object Oriented Language like Java or Kotlin
  • Experience building complex web applications with React is a plus
  • Experience building android applications with Kotlin is a plus
  • Focused on delivering positive impact for Toast customers
  • Experience delivering high quality, reliable services to production
  • Enjoys working in a team environment with a shared code-base

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy
We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits.

Pay Range
$95,000—$145,000 CAD

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is Baked into our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry is one of the most diverse, and we embrace that diversity with authenticity, inclusivity, respect, and humility. By embedding these principles into our culture and design, we create equitable opportunities for all and raise the bar in delivering exceptional experiences.

We Thrive Together

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the restaurant community. To learn more about how we work globally and regionally, check out: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast.

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. Job Title: Bilingual Customer Support Specialist (English-Spanish)

Location: Remote

Job Type: Full-time

About Us:

Mira Staffing is committed to empowering businesses by providing highly skilled virtual assistants to clients worldwide. Our mission is to help everyone thrive, not just survive, by prioritizing people, fostering growth and excellence, and valuing every contribution.﻿

Job Summary: The Remote Bilingual Customer Support Specialist (English-Spanish) plays a crucial role in engaging prospective and existing customers via phone and email. This position is responsible for delivering sales pitches, handling inquiries, and scheduling home inspections or pest control services to drive revenue growth through direct sales.﻿

The ideal candidate is fluent in both English and Spanish, possesses excellent communication skills, has a strong sales mindset, and understands customer service principles.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer Engagement:

  • Receive inbound and make outbound calls to prospective and existing customers in English and Spanish to promote home inspection and pest control services.
  • Deliver compelling sales pitches to persuade customers to purchase services or upgrade to higher-value packages.
  • Explain service features and benefits clearly, addressing customer concerns and objections effectively.
  • Actively listen to customers to understand their needs and provide appropriate solutions.

Appointment Scheduling & Coordination:

  • Handle inbound inquiries regarding service costs, appointment availability, and general information in both English and Spanish.
  • Use scheduling software to book home inspections and pest control services efficiently.
  • Contact Realtors and clients to confirm property access, verify appointment details, and ensure smooth scheduling.
  • Utilize Google Maps to determine service areas and assess driving distances between appointments.

Data Management & Follow-ups:

  • Obtain and record customer information, including contact details and service preferences.
  • Maintain and update customer databases with accurate and timely information.
  • Follow up with interested customers to secure sales or finalize appointments.

Professionalism & Growth Activities:

  • Handle rejection professionally and maintain a positive, results-driven attitude.
  • Support social media marketing and management efforts as needed.

Qualifications:

  • ﻿Bilingual fluency in English and Spanish (both written and spoken).
  • Excellent communication skills: Clear, engaging, and persuasive verbal communication with minimal accent.
  • Strong sales ability: Confidence in making sales pitches, overcoming objections, and closing deals.
  • Customer service expertise: Patience, active listening, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Organizational skills: Ability to manage schedules, update databases, and track customer interactions efficiently.
  • Resilience & motivation: Ability to handle rejections and stay goal-oriented.
  • Technical proficiency: Familiarity with Microsoft Office, Google Suite, and CRM or scheduling software.
  • Previous experience in real estate, home inspection, call center sales, or virtual assistance is a plus.
  • Familiarity with CRM software and sales tracking tools.
  • Ability to work in a target-driven sales environment.

System Requirements:

  • ﻿Computer: Minimum Intel i5 processor, 8GB RAM, Windows 10 or higher.
  • Monitors: Two monitors for desktops OR an external monitor for laptops (recommended for backup management).
  • Internet: Stable wired connection with at least 100 Mbps speed (higher preferred for WiFi).
  • Backup Internet: A secondary internet source capable of handling full workload OR access to a backup location nearby.
  • Power Backup: Uninterrupted power supply for at least 8 hours OR a backup location accessible within 30 minutes.
  • Work Environment: Dedicated, quiet workspace conducive to professional communication.
  • Headset: Noise-canceling headset for clear audio during calls.

Additional Requirements:

  • ﻿Must be fluent in both English and Spanish.
  • No bad records from previous employers and no derogatory records.
  • Must pass required assessments and screening.

﻿Why Join Us?

  • ﻿Permanent remote work.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to work in a diverse and inclusive environment.
  • Career growth and professional development opportunities.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.

If you are looking for an exciting opportunity to utilize your bilingual skills, grow in a dynamic environment, and contribute to a thriving team, we encourage you to apply today!

raw.description:
Transform Youth Mental Health with Daybreak Health

Overview

Join our mission to make quality mental healthcare accessible to every student who needs it. At Daybreak Health, you'll be part of a movement dedicated to removing barriers to care and empowering young people to thrive emotionally and mentally.

We partner with over 60 school districts—including Kaiser Permanente—reaching more than one million students nationwide. Our clinicians enjoy the stability of consistent referrals and a meaningful caseload, allowing you to focus on what matters most: making a real difference in students' lives.

We're seeking compassionate, licensed mental health clinicians to provide teletherapy to students ages 11-24 throughout California. In this role, you'll deliver high-quality, evidence-based care while working alongside schools, families, and community partners to help students thrive. Every session you lead has the power to change a young person's trajectory—and that's just the beginning of the impact you'll make.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $70–$85 per session, plus guaranteed pay for no-shows and late cancellations.
  • Flexible & Manageable Caseload: Start with a minimum of just 5 sessions per week — perfect for work-life balance. Most of our clinicians choose to provide 10 sessions per week, and we encourage you to work toward that as you settle in.

Your Path to W-2 Employment & Full Benefits

At Daybreak, we invest in clinicians who are ready to grow with us. Once you consistently reach 17 completed sessions per week, you'll have the opportunity to transition into our W-2 role, a part-time commitment that comes with the stability and benefits.

As a W-2 employee, you'll receive:

  • 💰 Base salary of $55,000/year with the opportunity to earn over $115,000 annually through monthly session bonuses ($70 per session beyond 17/week)
  • 🏥 Comprehensive health coverage — Daybreak covers up to 90% of your medical premium (dental and vision fully covered); 65% coverage for eligible dependents
  • 🗓️ Work-life balance — 11 paid holidays, 4 mental health days, and 60 hours of PTO per year
  • 📈 401(k) plan
  • 🧠 Professional support — Clinical guidance from experienced team leads and a clinical director to help you meet and exceed your goals

Prefer to stay independent? Clinicians who wish to remain as 1099 Independent Contractors are welcome to do so — we support whatever arrangement works best for your lifestyle and career goals. At Daybreak, flexibility isn't just a perk, it's part of how we work.

Flexibility & Clinical Support

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the U.S.
  • Flexible Schedule: Set your hours Monday–Friday, 3–8 PM PST, with optional weekend availability from 9 AM–5 PM PST.
  • Administrative Support: We handle billing, credentialing, and scheduling—so you can focus on care
  • Supportive Clinical Community: Peer consultation, collaborative networks, and team discussions
  • Professional Development: Continuing education credits and ongoing training

Role & Responsibilities

  • Foster strong, supportive relationships with students to create a safe therapeutic environment
  • Provide evidence-based individual teletherapy to students ages 11–24 experiencing mild-to-moderate mental health conditions
  • Provide psychoeducation to parents/caregivers

Qualifications

  • Licensed Professional with LCSW, LPCC, LMFT, or LP credentials in the State of California
  • Passion for youth mental health: Demonstrated commitment to providing culturally responsive, equitable care that honors diverse backgrounds and experiences
  • Experience working with teens and youth ages 11-24 in clinical or school settings
  • Comfortable with telehealth: Experience providing telehealth services

Please note: This role is open to fully licensed clinicians only; associate and provisionally licensed clinicians are not eligible.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Marketing Manager

We are seeking a creative and proactive multi-talented Marketing Manager to build and scale the Marketing function for Unify America’s Civic Gym program.

About Unify America

We’re on a mission to replace political fighting with collaborative problem-solving. Yeah, we know it sounds audacious. It is. But we’re doing it—by creating civic experiences that reduce polarization, teaching essential civic skills, and inviting Americans to use their differences to better solve common problems together.

Where we work:

  • Higher Education (Civic Gym): The Civic Gym allows college students to engage in meaningful cross-partisan conversations. Think of it as training for democracy—reps, sweat, and all. We partner with colleges and universities across the country to pair students for productive, skill-building dialogue across differences. So far, over 40,000 college students have paired up with strangers across the country to solve the country's most pressing issues.

  • Cities (Democracy Leagues): We partner with communities to run Civic Assemblies, where residents—across the ideological spectrum—solve shared problems together. Our first pilot is thriving in Akron, OH. We’re consulting with the City of Dayton, and we’ll likely will add another Ohio location by the end of the year.

About the Role

The Marketing Manager role will help support the entire Marketing function, from top-of-funnel lead generation and content creation work to supporting retention and customer account growth. Alongside the Director of Marketing, this role will own a variety of digital marketing work, including blog and whitepaper creation, email marketing, webinar support, conference and press strategy, and more. We are looking for a Marketing generalist who is excited to wear a lot of hats, learn a lot, and help build a department – you will be joining a 1-person Marketing team. Your work will directly influence the growth and future of the department and the organization.

This role will work closely with the entire organization, including our Partnerships team who is responsible for selling to new educators and campuses, as well as the Creative team and the organization’s President. This role will report to the Director of Marketing. We’re focused on building this program right, not optimizing for short-term numbers or goals.

This Marketing Manager is a generalist who is responsible for building and executing work across the Marketing funnel:

  • This role will support the growth of the Civic Gym program by executing, tracking, and scaling our organic digital marketing work to help more college educators and campuses adopt the program, alongside the Director of Marketing.

  • A large portion of this role will focus on creating different Marketing content to meet educators and administrators where they’re at, including: gated content and blogs to bring in new leads, creating resources and content to help our current customers grow their usage on campuses, supporting our partnerships team with conference materials and webinar support, and email marketing strategy and creation.

  • This role is about realistic creativity – we want someone to help us build a scalable, reliable Marketing program that extends across multiple marketing channels, including top of funnel and retention. As a nonprofit, we are often working on lean budgets and short timeframes, so a scrappy, flexible approach will be key

  • We are currently focused on organic and relationship-driven channels, though the right candidate will be open to exploring new channels as the program evolves.

  • The ideal candidate is a Marketing generalist who thrives in creative, scalable thinking and tactical execution, and thrives in a small, startup environment. They will be the second Marketing hire – they should be excited by the flexibility to define the scope of their role and to hone many different skills.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years experience in a Growth or Content Marketing function with broad experience in other areas of Marketing

  • Impeccable copywriting and copyediting abilities

  • Experience with Hubspot or another email automation platform

  • Proven ability to launch and scale digital marketing campaigns and channels

  • Comfort with campaign analytics, including monitoring KPIs and managing tracking for each campaign channel

  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills; able to thrive in smaller, fast-paced organizations.

  • Experience marketing in higher education a huge plus

  • Familiarity with Canva or other design software a plus

What else you bring

  • You are a strategic partner who is excited to jump in and help build a marketing engine – we will be a mighty team of 2

  • You are proactive at identifying opportunities and executing – without being asked

  • You have meticulous attention to detail and are always looking to make your campaigns 1% better

  • You thrive in ambiguity – you're comfortable turning ideas into campaigns and owning every part of the process without templates or previous examples

  • You know how to prioritize work, identify bottlenecks and tension points, and proactively identify issues – this role covers a wide range of tasks and being able to identify the most important things will be key

  • You love collaboration, but you’re also comfortable working independently

  • You believe in the importance of civil discourse and civic participation

Compensation & Benefits

  • Annual salary of $70,000 to $80,000, depending on relevant experience.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • 401k match up to 5%.

  • Internet and phone reimbursement.

  • A healthy, appreciative, feedback-driven workplace.

  • Flexible, self-managed PTO.

Ready to Apply?

Your application materials should include a cover letter that shares three reasons why you’re right for this job (and why it’s right for you) and your resume in one, combined PDF (there will only be one field for Resume in the application, and we are looking for a combined Cover Letter/Resume in that field).

Salary: 70K - 80K USD a year

We produce exciting and engaging entertainment for players across the globe and pride ourselves on developing top-quality casual games that invite and allow players to connect with one another.

We are looking for a sharp, data-driven Marketing Creative Producer to join our Marketing Creative team. In this role, you will act as the bridge between high-level creative strategy and execution, driving the production of high-impact marketing assets for our top-grossing mobile games. You will play a pivotal role in translating marketing insights into concrete creative concepts. Working closely with the Creative Strategist, you will be responsible for authoring detailed briefs, gameplay mockups and partnering with Art & Animation Leads to ensure those ideas are transformed into world-class video creatives that deliver results at scale.

Required time zone CET +/- 3 hours

Responsibilities

  • Translate the department’s strategy into actionable briefs by personally creating gameplay ideation mockups, game mechanics wireframes, and AI vibe-coded prototypes to visually define the narrative, hooks, and psychological triggers for all video and static creatives.

  • Analyze creative performance reports (provided by the UA team) to extract actionable insights. You will use this data to refine future briefs, identifying what works, what doesn't, and how to optimize for KPIs like IPM and CTR.
  • Conduct ongoing competitor research and market analysis to identify new trends, mechanics, and visual styles that can be adapted into our creative roadmap.
  • Drive a continuous feedback loop. You will not just launch campaigns but actively manage the iteration process, creating variations of winning concepts to maximize longevity and scale.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in a Creative Producer or Marketing Strategy role within the mobile gaming or performance marketing industry
  • Proven experience writing detailed creative briefs for design and animation teams
  • Strong understanding of mobile marketing KPIs (CTR, IPM, ROAS, Retention) and the ability to interpret data to drive creative decisions
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex creative ideas to both artistic and technical teams
  • Experience working in a high-volume, fast-paced production environment
  • Fluent English (written and spoken) - essential for brief writing

  • Experience working on Casual, Puzzle, Hypercasual or Social Casino titles
  • Background in User Acquisition or Product Marketing
  • Familiarity with project management tools (Monday.com, Jira)

Benefits

  • Join a global, data-driven company with a unique product and a strong R&D center;
  • Work in an exceptional, innovative, and dynamic environment;
  • Enjoy full transparency and open communication with colleagues;
  • Take advantage of tremendous opportunities for growth and career advancement
  • Influence and help build personalized product experiences for millions of users.

We Play to Win! We Play it Smart! We Play as a Team!

raw.description:
About DrFirst

For 25 years, DrFirst has empowered providers and patients to achieve better health through intelligent medication management. We improve healthcare workflows and help patients start and stay on therapy with end-to-end solutions that enhance prescription access, affordability, and adherence. Our solutions help 100 million patients a year and are used by more than 420,000 prescribers, 71,000 pharmacies, 270 EHRs and health information systems, and over 2,000 hospitals in the U.S. This is a great opportunity to be a part of a successful Healthcare IT company experiencing significant growth.

Here you will get to work with some of the smartest and most interesting people around, solving unique and complex challenges in healthcare on a scale matched by few companies. If you get excited about stretching yourself in new ways, developing yourself to your fullest potential, and care about working with smart colleagues, we want to talk to you!

Position Overview

The Senior Integration Engineer will lead the integration of medication data feeds from payer partners into DrFirst solutions. This role requires both technical excellence and strong relationship management skills, as you will own the ongoing business relationships with payer organizations while managing the continuous integration of their medication data.

You will play a critical role in scaling direct payer integrations and prior authorization workflows while owning both the technical execution and business relationships with payer partners. This role blends hands-on integration engineering, project leadership, and cross-functional collaboration with product to establish scalable processes and SOPs as payer connectivity grows.

You will serve as a technical and business-facing leader for payer integrations, helping transform complex payer workflows into reliable, repeatable, and scalable integration capabilities. As a senior member of the team, you will also serve as a technical resource and mentor for Integration Services Engineers, supporting medication management solution integrations into EMR/EHR platforms when needed.

This role requires managing multiple concurrent integration projects, maintaining strong payer relationships through regular communication and updates, and ensuring seamless delivery as payers continuously add new plans, update formularies, and introduce new data elements.

Who Will Love This Job

  • A relationship builder who excels at managing technical and business partnerships with external organizations
  • A project leadership professional who manages multiple payer integration projects simultaneously
  • A technical mentor who enjoys sharing knowledge with team members
  • A medication management specialist who understands pharmacy benefits and prior authorization workflows
  • A healthcare technology innovator who builds bridges between disparate healthcare technologies
  • A quality engineering leader who embeds testing, monitoring, and compliance into development
  • A continuous improvement catalyst who iteratively enhances integration processes

What you will work on

Payer Integration Ownership

  • Lead end-to-end integration of medication data feeds from national and regional payers
  • Design, build, and support direct payer integrations with UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, Cigna, Humana, BCBS
  • Act as technical subject matter expert for payer-specific integration requirements

Business Relationship Management

  • Serve as primary technical and business contact for payer partners
  • Own business and technical relationships with payer partners
  • Partner with payer stakeholders to align on requirements and timelines

Prior Authorization Integration Expertise

  • Build, maintain, and optimize prior authorization integrations
  • Troubleshoot complex PA issues across payer systems
  • Collaborate to improve authorization success rates

Team Technical Leadership

  • Act as escalation point and mentor for Integration Services Engineers
  • Build team capabilities through knowledge sharing and documentation

Product Partnership and SOP Development

  • Partner with Product Management to define scalable payer integration capabilities
  • Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures for repeatable delivery

Project Management & Integration Delivery

  • Own end-to-end integration projects from discovery through go-live
  • Manage timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder communication

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field
  • 5+ years in healthcare integration engineering with focus on payer connectivity
  • Deep understanding of healthcare data standards (HL7 FHIR, HL7 v2, X12 EDI)
  • Proven ability to manage external business relationships
  • Strong project management skills coordinating multiple concurrent projects
  • Experience with Java, C#, Python, JavaScript/Node.js
  • Background in CI/CD, automated testing, and cloud platforms (AWS)
  • Understanding of HIPAA, HITECH, and healthcare regulatory requirements

Preferred:

  • Experience with payer organizations on technical integrations
  • Knowledge of pharmacy benefit management (PBM) systems
  • Background in mentoring less experienced engineers
  • Experience with EMR/EHR integration patterns
  • Experience with microservices and event-driven architectures
  • Knowledge of healthcare interoperability initiatives (TEFCA, CMS)

Physical Requirements

  • 95% Desk work
  • Less than 5% travel to industry events and annual team onsite

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, with a base salary of $120,000 - $140,000 (Exact compensation may vary based on skills and experience)
  • Eligible for a Discretionary Performance-based bonus
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401K eligible after 3 months of employment, with 50% company match up to first 5% of salary contributed to the plan with a 3-year vesting schedule
  • HSA for eligible employees enrolled in the HDHP, with a generous company contribution up to $500 for individual coverage and $1000 for family coverage per year
  • 100% company paid short and long-term disability, AD&D, and group life insurance
  • Accrued annual paid time off (PTO) of 18 days for the first 3 years of service, increasing thereafter and 7 paid holiday days
  • Employee Assistance Program
